text: At its meeting on April 26, 27 and 28, 2017, City Council authorized the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to accept an in-kind donation of up to $1 million from and enter into a construction agreement with St. George's (Islington) Church Nursery School Inc. for the Humbertown Park revitalization project: http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2017.PE18.3 Due to an increase in costs related to this project, the donation from St. George's (Islington) Church Nursery School Inc. may be valued as high as $2 million. In compliance with the City's Policy on Donations for Community Benefits, Council authority is required to accept this in-kind donation. In addition, Section 37 funds totaling $150,000 have been secured and received by the City from the development at 4180, 4186, 4186A and 4190 Dundas Street West. City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to accept the additional in-kind donation of up to $1 million from St. George's (Islington) Church Nursery School Inc. for the Humbertown Park revitalization project, for a total in-kind donation of up to $2 million, in compliance with the policy on Donations to the City of Toronto for Community Benefits. 2.
